_doc: Les pages des plugins (2026-11-25) : /mm-rytm/ et /mm-arp/. Lu par src/v4/ui/sections/PluginPage.tsx et scripts/prerender-seo.mjs. Les systemes et les zips : public/data/vst.json.

mmrytm.alt: MM-RYTM, the drum machine by Maudite Machine
mmrytm.lead: The drum machine of this site, as a free VST3 plugin, with the same face and the same sound. Build your beats in Ableton Live or any VST3 host, sequenced by your DAW or by its own clock.
features: 16 tracks, up to 64 steps, swing and velocities
Nine synth engines (909, 808 and MM kits) and a sample layer on every track
Parameter locks, conditional trigs, probability, micro timing and retrigs
Filter, envelope, tone, distortion and chorus per track; delay, reverb, glue and limiter on the master
Two LFOs per voice and a crossfader between scenes A and B
Follows your DAW transport, plays GM MIDI notes, saves everything in your project

mmarp.alt: MM-ARP, the synthesizer and arpeggiator by Maudite Machine
mmarp.lead: The synth and arpeggiator of this site, as a free VST3 plugin, with the same face. Chords, arpeggios and basslines that lock to your DAW tempo.
features: Two oscillators, a sub and a ladder filter, ported line by line from the web synth
Arpeggiator and chord pads, timed to your DAW position
Juno style chorus, ping-pong and tape delay, reverb
Factory presets for bass, acid, sequences and chords; save your own
Every knob is a host parameter: automate it, map it to your controller
